Oven-Roasted Crispy Chickpeas

Oven-roasted chickpeas that turn deeply crunchy. Drying them thoroughly before tossing in oil is crucial—any remaining moisture will steam them instead of roasting them.

Prep
5 min prep
Total / resting
30 min total
Ingredients & Method ↓

Development edition · Awaits kitchen testing.

Ingredients Method Storage

Ingredients

How many people?
2

Estimated to serve 2 people as a snack or topping.

  • 1 can chickpeas, drained and thoroughly dried
    Package size: 15 oz / 425 g.
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • Salt to taste
  • Pinch of paprika (optional)

None standard. Check all ingredient labels.

Method

01

Dry thoroughly

Dry the chickpeas thoroughly with a clean towel before roasting — removing surface moisture allows them to crisp up properly rather than steaming.

02

Coat and roast

Toss the dried chickpeas with olive oil directly on a bare baking sheet, spreading them in a single layer. Roast at 425°F/220°C for about 25-30 minutes, shaking the pan halfway through until golden and crisp.

Look for: Deep golden brown, dry, and brittle.

03

Season immediately

Toss with salt and paprika immediately after taking them out of the oven, while still hot, so the spices stick.

Serve with

Eat them on their own as a snack or scatter them over salads for extra crunch. Estimated to serve 2 people as a snack or topping.

One way to change it up

Try smoked paprika, cumin, or a pinch of cayenne for a different flavor profile.

A small technique note

The more carefully you dry the chickpeas with a clean towel, the crispier they will become in the oven.

Storage & Prep ahead

Keep at 40°F (4°C) or colder. Refrigerate within 2 hours of preparation, or within 1 hour above 90°F (32°C). Discard if left out longer. Storage life depends on ingredient freshness and preparation.
